data.name: Daleep
data.gender_notes: Daleep is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Daleep is derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'lamp of God'. This name is often given to a child who is believed to be a divine presence in the family, bringing light and guidance. In Hindu mythology, Daleep is associated with the god Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe. The name Daleep carries the meaning “Lamp of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Daleep usually hope their child will grow to embody lamp of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Daleep is a name for those who possess inner strength, courage, and the ability to overcome challenges. It signifies the power of the individual to shape their own destiny.
data.etymology: Daleep belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lamp of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daleep total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
